name: Softwood timber and lumber products subject to 10% Section 232 duty (Proclamation 10976, effective October 14, 2025)
notes: HTSUS heading 9903.76.01: 10% ad valorem on softwood timber and lumber products (all countries).
No country-specific exceptions for softwood — UK, EU, Japan caps apply only to furniture/cabinet codes.
Products subject to this proclamation are NOT subject to Section 122 surcharge (Section 232 stacking rule).
By October 1, 2026 the Secretary must report on hardwood timber; hardwood tariffs may follow.
Amended December 31, 2025: rate increases for furniture/cabinets deferred to January 1, 2027 (not applicable to softwood tier).
